description: Expose one optional Seat pilot per eligible hosted sponsor, independently of signup.
Bind one pilot to one client, allocation and technician under the normal setup permissions.
Separate pilot funding from purchased quantity, paid usage and base seats.
Resume pending setup, resend or replace an unused invitation, and invalidate its old binding.
Start the immutable fifteen-day interval on first successful technician sign-in.
Apply base subscription availability and the pilot deadline to every pilot access decision.
Preserve scoped identity, MSP work and history through expiry, early end and recovery.
Show terms, dates and actionable status in the overview and client setup.
Convert the same assignment explicitly with available paid capacity or confirmed checkout.
Reconcile failed, concurrent and retried conversion operations without duplicate charges or lost capacity.
Capture sign-in, shared ticket activity and conversion once per pilot milestone.
Keep CE and appliance paths inert and honor deployment gates while servicing existing pilots.
